metadata.title: Land Registry ZKP
metadata.description: Privacy-preserving Land Use Rights registry using a Merkle tree and Zero-Knowledge Proofs on Ethereum

landing.residentTitle: Check a land title without reading the file.
landing.residentBody: An owner generates a proof in their own browser. A buyer, bank or agency checks it against the root the registry published on Ethereum.
landing.govBody: Issue certificates, handle transfers at the counter, and publish batched changes to the registry root. Requires an officer key and a wallet.

gate.title: Registry officer sign-in
gate.intro: The portal key authenticates this browser to the registry API. Publishing a root is signed separately, with your wallet.
gate.label: Portal key
gate.hint: Held for this tab only. Closing it signs you out.
gate.errorRejected: That key was rejected by the registry API.
gate.errorUnreachable: Could not reach the registry API. The key was not checked.
gate.errorUnreachableDetail: Could not reach the registry API ({detail}). The key was not checked.

govImport.title: Import records
govImport.description: Upload a cadastral CSV export. Every row is validated against the statutory land-use code table before it can be issued.
govImport.emptyBody: Drop a .csv export here or browse for one. The file is checked row by row first; nothing is written until you import the valid rows.
govImport.checkedTitle: Checked {name} — nothing has been written yet
govImport.catalogEmptyBody: Commune names in this file could not be checked against the units in force. Seed the catalog with pnpm --filter backend run seed:admin-units <file> before relying on these addresses.
govImport.errorsBody: Fix these in the source export and upload the file again. Superseded land codes, renamed agencies and district-tier addresses are rejected as invalid values; the registry does not translate outdated data.
govImport.noValidRows: No row in this file can be imported.
govImport.committedBody: They are now IMPORTED and can be selected for issuance. {skipped} row(s) were skipped because their property ID was already registered.

govIssuance.title: Issuance
govIssuance.description: Select imported properties, sign the new Merkle root with your wallet, then download the certificate archive.
govIssuance.emptyBody: Properties appear here once a CSV import has been accepted. Import a file first, then come back to draft a batch.

govTransfers.title: Transfers
govTransfers.description: Run a transfer with both parties present, then work the approval queue. Approving queues the change, it does not publish it.
govTransfers.emptyBody: Transfers submitted at the counter wait here for a second officer to approve or reject them.

govChanges.title: Changes
govChanges.description: Collect approved transfers and revocations into one ChangeSet, sign it, and publish a single new root.
govChanges.emptyBody: Approved transfers and queued revocations collect here. Batching them means one root publish instead of one per change.

residentProof.title: Generate a proof
residentProof.description: Prove a fact about your title without handing over the certificate. The proof is computed on this device and your secret never leaves it.
residentProof.emptyBody: Select the ZIP you received from the registry. It holds the receipt and the secret needed to compute a proof, both of which stay in this browser.

residentVerify.title: Verify a proof
residentVerify.description: Check a proof against the registry root published on chain, confirm the issuing authority, and see whether the title has been revoked.
residentVerify.emptyBody: Upload the proof.json an owner gave you. You will see which claims it establishes, and nothing about the record beyond them.

residentLookup.title: Property history
residentLookup.description: Every registry event for a parcel, by its property ID. Owners appear as commitments, never as names.
residentLookup.label: Property ID
residentLookup.emptyBody: Parcel IDs run from 0 to 1048575, the range of the depth-20 tree. The history shows issuance, transfers and revocations with the root version each was published under.

govShell.outOfSyncTitle: The database and the chain disagree
govShell.outOfSyncBody: A draft may have been signed but not confirmed yet, or the local node was restarted while the database kept its rows. Open the waiting draft, or check the node.
govShell.draftOpenIssuance: Issuance draft #{id} is waiting to be signed or confirmed.
govShell.draftOpenChangeset: Change set draft #{id} is waiting to be signed or confirmed.

govDraft.chainUnavailable: The registry contract could not be read
govDraft.stepConnect: Connect the officer wallet that holds the state-authority role to sign this root.
govDraft.stepWrongChain: The wallet is on chain {actual}. This registry is on chain {expected}; a root signed elsewhere is one the registry never reads.
govDraft.stepNoRole: {account} does not hold STATE_AUTHORITY_ROLE on this registry. Select the authority account in the wallet.
govDraft.stepSign: Sign the new root with the wallet. Nothing in the registry changes until the transaction is mined and the draft is confirmed.
govDraft.stepConfirm: This root is already on chain. Confirm to apply the draft to the registry.
govDraft.mining: Waiting for the transaction to be mined
govDraft.confirming: Applying the draft to the registry
govDraft.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? Nothing was published; its contents return to the queue.
govDraft.invalidatesProofs: Publishing replaces the root every issued Merkle proof refers to. Owners refresh their proof automatically before proving.
govDraft.pendingTransfers: {count} transfer(s) awaiting approval were proven against the current root. Once this publishes, approving them fails with RootMismatch and both parties must return to the counter.
govDraft.notOnChainYet: The chain does not hold this root yet

govErrors.badRequest: The registry rejected the request as invalid
govErrors.unauthorized: The portal key is no longer valid
govErrors.conflict: The registry refused this in its current state
govErrors.unprocessable: The registry could not apply this
govErrors.rootMismatch: The registry root has moved on since this proof was made
govErrors.staleTimestamp: The proof timestamp is outside the 10-minute window
govErrors.invalidProof: The proof is not cryptographically valid
govErrors.unreachable: Could not reach the registry API
govErrors.walletRejected: The signature was cancelled in the wallet
govErrors.walletDuplicateRoot: This root is already the latest root on chain
govErrors.walletNoRole: The wallet account does not hold the state-authority role
govErrors.walletAlreadyRevoked: A plot in this change set is already revoked on chain; discard the draft
govErrors.walletInvalidRevocation: The contract rejected the revocation data; discard the draft
govErrors.walletUnknown: The transaction did not go through
